title: Honey from the Hives

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: The wool arrived, thank you! And today we take honey from the hives. The bees have worked all summer.

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: Will you pour the honey into the jars? Each jar has a line. Honey is slow, so be patient.

steps.speaker: elias
steps.prompt: Fill each jar to its line. Hold the pot over a jar, and let go at the line.

older.prompt: Fill each jar to its line: a quarter, half, three quarters, and full.

feedback.too_full: Oops, over the line! Tap that jar to pour it back.
feedback.all_good: Golden honey, every jar just right. The bees would be proud.

outro.speaker: elias
outro.text: Taste? Sweet as summer. We leave plenty in the hives, so the bees have enough for the winter too.

journal_line: I poured honey into jars at the monastery with Brother Elias.
